kpis.description_fr: Production totale ~470 kBOE/j post-acquisition Endeavor Energy (sep 2024). Pure-play Permian le plus gros.
kpis.description_en: Total production ~470 kBOE/d post Endeavor Energy acquisition (Sep 2024). Largest pure-play Permian.

kpis.description_fr: Production huile = ~60 % du total. Maximum exposure WTI. Permian basin = inventaire premium pluri-décennal.
kpis.description_en: Oil production = ~60% of total. Maximum WTI exposure. Permian basin = multi-decade premium inventory.

kpis.description_fr: Acquisition Endeavor Energy closée sept 2024 pour ~26 Mds $. Quasi-double inventory premium Permian Midland. Plus gros deal Permian.
kpis.description_en: Endeavor Energy acquisition closed Sep 2024 for ~$26B. Nearly doubles Midland Permian premium inventory. Largest Permian deal.

kpis.description_fr: Surface nette ~870k acres Permian post-Endeavor. Largest Permian footprint. Concentration Midland + Delaware basins.
kpis.description_en: Net acreage ~870k acres Permian post-Endeavor. Largest Permian footprint. Midland + Delaware basin concentration.

kpis.description_fr: Capital returns = ~75 % du FCF (dividend fixe + variable + buybacks). Discipline pionnière secteur. Modèle privilégié actionnaires.
kpis.description_en: Capital returns = ~75% of FCF (fixed + variable dividend + buybacks). Sector-pioneering discipline. Shareholder-friendly model.
